snippet.title: Experience the Best Version of GTAV and GTA Online on PC with GTAV Enhanced
snippet.description:
Upgrade to GTAV Enhanced — free to all players who already own GTAV on PC and loaded with optimizations to improve the game experience and performance for modern PCs.

Easily migrate your Story Mode and Online progress to this newly upgraded version and enjoy a number of technical improvements, including ray traced shadows and reflections first seen on the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S versions, as well as PC-only features such as ray traced ambient occlusion and global illumination, support for AMD FSR and NVIDIA DLSS, and more.
